text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...!
――Hah!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (—Look, and understand my story.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Don't look away! Keep your eyes glued on me!
Proof that even someone like me can captivate someone's gaze—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I need you all to be my witnesses!!
Please...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The winner is Zenno Rob Roy!!
What a spectacular victory for Zenno Rob Roy!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The second crown of autumn shines above her head!!
With only the Arima Kinen left, will she become the second Triple Crown winner in history!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: No one can take their eyes off the outcome of this magnificent challenge—a tale worthy of being called an epic saga!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haa... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kh, the second crown... I, I did it...!!
choice_data_list: Yeah...! You're truly incredible, Rob Roy!
Yeah...! You're really amazing, Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ah...
...*huff*...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... S-Sorry.
I just... can't quite... catch my breath yet."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, there was hardly any time between races, after all.
It's only natural that fatigue would build up.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still... I will do it.
Even so, I will see it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Right...? Trainer-san...?!
choice_data_list: ...Let's make sure we win our final Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah, Zenno Rob Roy in the Japan Cup was, like... seriously insane...!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it, that girl...
her presence and drive just keep growing stronger, don't they?”

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"She has this 'I'm definitely doing this! I won't give up victory!!' vibe...
Even though she seems quiet, the passion she shows is just burning hot."

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Right~...!
...Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey!!
Isn't that over there...?!
